_comment: Surface the OpenClaw release watch (.github/workflows/openclaw-watch.yml) compares across upstream releases. Hand-maintained; update it in PRs that change what the plugin or tlawn relies on.
configKeys: config keys tlawn writes (tlonbot repo); a removed zod-schema line defining one becomes a check: hint.
extensions: upstream extensions/<name> trees we enable; diffed alongside the SDK entry files and extraPaths (git pathspecs, globs allowed).
workarounds: patches/strips we carry; Jev is asked per relevant bullet whether the change makes each one unnecessary.

profile: the plugin_profile state sent to Jev with every bullet; keep it in step with what we actually run. The three <filled at label time: …> entries are replaced by label.ts from the digest (imported subpaths, prod pins and compared releases, CI Node and the next release's engines.node); label.ts fails if one is missing.

workarounds.note: Pioneer image patches OpenClaw so a provider fallback continues the turn instead of ending it
tlawn strips 8.x-only config keys (agents.entries, memorySearch, …) when the installed core is 7.1

profile.what: Tlon Messenger is a channel plugin for OpenClaw (package @tloncorp/openclaw). Each hosted bot is one OpenClaw gateway in a container, configured at boot by a Python entrypoint (tlawn) that writes the OpenClaw config file.
plugin_uses: <filled at label time: imported plugin-sdk subpaths>

channel plugin contract: inbound message dispatch, outbound replies and reply chunking, typing callbacks, reactions, media/attachments, DM and group chat types, allowlists (dmAllowlist/ownerAllowFrom)
plugin hooks: before_agent_finalize, heartbeat_prompt_contribution, tool-result handling
message tool and agent tools registered by the plugin; skills loaded from a workspace directory
host_config_written_by_tlawn: agents.list / agents.entries (keyed roster, default agent marker)
agents.defaults.heartbeat (every, prompt, target, to, isolatedSession, lightContext, directPolicy)
plugins.allow (tlon, codex, brave, lossless), plugin install ledger under ~/.openclaw/plugins
models.providers.openrouter with apiKey and auth api-key; model selection via OpenRouter
state DB (SQLite) under the moon pier; one-way schema migrations matter for rollback
deployment: <filled at label time: production OpenClaw versions and the releases compared>
<filled at label time: plugin CI Node version and the Node range OpenClaw requires>

gateway runs headless in a container, with OpenClaw installed at boot via npm; no desktop app, no macOS/Windows/iOS/Android clients, no voice, no browser automation, no Discord/Telegram/Slack/iMessage/WhatsApp/Signal channels
the hosting image applies a patch to OpenClaw for fallback-continuation behaviour; the entrypoint strips 8.x-only config keys when running 7.1
